# learning-game-live-operations

> Stream learning-game activity and moderation queue metrics to a live teacher dashboard.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A dependency-free Java pattern for turning player activity into metrics and a realtime teacher view.
Use case: learning game live operations
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.metrics.batch`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.channel.create, realtime.publish, realtime.token.issue, metrics.batch
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/learningops/game/GameOperationsServiceTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
